darknessPresets.name: 50 h darkness limit (from VIPER's design)
darknessPresets.option: 50 h · design figure from NASA's VIPER rover
darknessPresets.quote: "The rover cannot endure more than 50 hours of continuous darkness."
darknessPresets.basis: "The rover cannot endure more than 50 hours of continuous darkness." VIPER was a rover meant to move to sunlit areas; here 50 h is used as a limit for a lander that stays in one place.
darknessPresets.note: VIPER was a rover meant to move to sunlit areas; here 50 h is used as a limit for a lander that stays in one place.

artemisRegions.description: NASA Artemis candidate landing regions (about 15 km across). Outlines from the published 2022 region grids; the October 2024 list was made for Artemis III, which NASA redesignated in 2026 as a low-Earth-orbit demonstration (Artemis IV is now the first crewed landing). New 2024 regions have no published outline.

sources.terrain: NASA PGDA 5 m site maps (Barker et al. 2021); LRO LOLA 20 m, 80 m and 64 px/deg maps
